name: FullStack Bench
abstract: FullStack Bench evaluates LLMs as full-stack coders. The displayed leaderboard uses the Overall score from the main results table.
contributions: The benchmark goes beyond standalone coding tasks and targets end-to-end full-stack development.
This page keeps Overall as the primary leaderboard instead of splitting every domain-specific subscore.
method: FullStack Bench moves beyond isolated coding tasks and targets broader full-stack development ability.
It covers domains such as basic programming, data analysis, software engineering, math, and machine learning.
The benchmark uses real-world instructions and unit tests across 16 widely used programming languages.
The paper also releases SandboxFusion to execute and evaluate these multilingual tasks reliably.
Results show that full-stack evaluation is both more realistic and more challenging than traditional code benchmarks.
leaderboard_note: The leaderboard shows the Overall score from the main experiments table. The paper also reports finer frontend/backend subscores, which are not expanded here.
